subject: Follow-up: prompt-output handling and residency constraints
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@veridianhealth.com>, James Porter <james.porter@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: prompt-output handling and residency constraints

Hi Emma / James —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side related to the PII/data-handling items you raised:

1) What Redwood stores by default
- Prompt text (input) and model outputs are not persisted indefinitely on hosted plans; default diagnostic retention is 30 days and is used only for debugging and quality monitoring.
- We store minimal request metadata (timestamp, model id, region, and a hashed request id) for routing/observability. IPs are not stored in user-facing logs by default on hosted.

2) Customer options and controls
- For customers needing shorter retention windows (e.g., 7 days) or zero retention, we can:
  • Offer TTL enforcement at the storage layer for prompt/output artifacts (requires Dedicated or Private deployments for contractual guarantees).
  • Enable field-level redaction via our SDK to remove PII before it reaches our servers.
  • Offer customer-managed encryption keys (KMS) in Private deployments; in hosted plans we use Redwood-managed keys with AES-256 encryption at rest.

3) Residency and logging
- Data can be pinned to US or EU regions for both storage and audit logs on Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Audit logs and structured request traces are available for 90 days and can be extended under an enterprise agreement.

4) Next steps I propose
- I attached our privacy matrix (redwood_privacy_matrix_v2.xlsx) and a short requirements form (veridian_pii_requirements_form.pdf) so you can indicate the exact retention, key-management, and residency constraints you need.
- If you confirm a 7-day TTL + customer-managed keys requirement, I will route this to Solutions + Legal to validate feasibility and provide a formal quote / amendment.

Action: Could you confirm whether Veridian requires: (A) 7-day TTL for prompt & outputs, (B) customer-managed keys, and (C) US-only residency? If any of these are "yes" we'll prioritize Solutions engagement.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priym.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@veridianhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: James Porter <james.porter@veridianhealth.com>, procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-16T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: prompt-output handling and residency constraints

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our security team: 

- Primary ask: We need a 7-day TTL for any prompt text and model outputs retained for debugging.
- We must have the ability to bring our own keys (BYOK) so that Redwood cannot decrypt after the key revocation.
- Please confirm whether session-level logs store full prompt text or only hashed IDs in the hosted offering. If full prompts are stored even for 30 days, that won’t meet our compliance.
- Also need confirmation on whether any telemetry escapes US-only (we must ensure EU/RoW tokens are not replicated to the US).

If Hosted can't meet BYOK + 7-day contractual TTL, we are prepared to evaluate Dedicated or Private but need a clear migration path and cost delta.

Can you confirm by EOD Tuesday? If easier, we can schedule a 20-min follow-up call.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Security Lead, Veridian Health
emma.liu@veridianhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0210

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-05-16T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: prompt-output handling and residency constraints

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Veridian's clarifying asks (see below). Key asks: 7-day TTL, BYOK, confirmation about whether hosted session logs persist full prompt text.

They indicated Hosted may be insufficient if we cannot guarantee BYOK + contractual TTL. We should confirm:
- Can Solutions propose a Dedicated/Private configuration with enforced 7-day TTL and KMS integration?
- If Hosted can be configured to redact inputs before persistence (SDK redaction or tokenization), can we offer that as an interim solution?

I attached the filled requirements form they returned; they flagged BYOK as mandatory.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-05-16T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up: prompt-output handling and residency constraints

Thanks for the flag, Priyom. Short answer and recommended path: 

- Hosted: cannot provide contractual BYOK today; hosted offers 30-day diagnostic retention and uses Redwood-managed keys. We do offer SDK-side redaction to remove PII prior to transit, which is a viable interim mitigation but requires engineering changes on their side.
- Dedicated/Private: both support enforced TTL at the storage layer and BYOK/KMS integrations; residency can be constrained to US or EU and audit logs can be restricted accordingly. This is the safer contractual fit for Veridian's asks.

Recommended next steps: 
1) Rishi — please coordinate with Solutions to prepare a short SOW estimating Dedicated vs Private delta addressing: 7-day TTL enforcement, BYOK, migration timeline, and cost.
2) Priyom — respond to Emma today acknowledging Hosted constraints, offering SDK redaction as interim, and proposing a Solutions call to review Dedicated/Private SOW next week.

I'll be available on Wed morning if we need to join the call.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
